provenance.source: Browser development project: Live test - Independent educator tools

scope.title: Live test - Independent educator tools
scope.domain: Explore recurring problems faced by independent educators running paid technical courses, cohort programs, and small tutoring businesses. Look for software startup opportunities in learner feedback, assessment, practice, course maintenance, scheduling, and business operations. Seek first-hand evidence, existing alternatives, and willingness-to-pay signals. Cover distinct problems rather than variations of a generic AI tutor.
scope.audience: Independent technical educators, cohort-course operators, and small tutoring businesses with 1-10 staff
scope.observations: Prefer simple focused products with a clear paying buyer. Separate observed evidence from inference. We intend to explore 30 ideas across three distinct discovered problems, 10 ideas per problem.
offLimits: No dependence on exclusive enterprise data or major partnerships to launch
No unsupported market-size or revenue claims
scope.riskEvaluationCriteria: A student developer building a bootstrapped software business. A useful first version should be feasible for one strong TypeScript developer in 6-8 weeks, with modest operating costs and reachable early customers. Evaluate demand, competition, access to necessary data, and realistic sales effort.
